info.title: Kezek HTTP API
info.description: Source inventory of explicit Next route exports. Only operations marked reviewed have typed wire contracts. Inventory-only operations do not specify authentication, input or response schemas. This is not a deployment or full compatibility guarantee. See SWAGGER_SETUP.md and API_DOCUMENTATION.md in the repository.

servers.description: Same origin. SDK consumers must configure their own approved base URL.

x-inventory-boundary: Explicit route exports including .tsx and local re-exports; no implicit framework HEAD/OPTIONS, middleware, rewrites, direct Supabase or deployment validation.

bearerAuth.description: Verified Supabase access token. Some browser flows additionally support the existing session cookies, as described per operation.

start_at.description: A valid date with seconds and timezone; fractional seconds are not accepted by the HTTP validator.

QuickHoldInput.description: Either service_id or a non-empty services array is required. If services is supplied it must be non-empty even when service_id is also supplied. Unknown keys are stripped. Calendar, schedule and tenant validity are enforced by the server.

start_at.description: A valid date with seconds and timezone; fractional seconds are not accepted by the HTTP validator.

QuickBookGuestInput.description: Unknown keys are stripped. Business rules and service availability are validated on the server.

clientId.description: Stable client-generated identity for a new draft row.

ShiftItemInput.description: No note field is accepted. Amounts may be fractional. Omitted amounts default to zero.

SaveShiftItemsInput.description: Both expected fields must refer to the draft snapshot. Both null only for a manager creating a previously absent shift on the current business-local day. For an existing shift, the stored shift date is authoritative; an explicit shiftDate must match it. Never rebase a stale draft automatically. staffId selects the manager cookie-session path; staff mode supports a verified bearer or cookie session.

CloseShiftInput.description: The supplied items must match the saved ledger. Close finalizes saved positions; it does not save draft edits. A non-empty items array or totalAmount is required. Identity and revision belong to the original draft.

ClosedShift.description: Only these fields are modeled for the SDK. The endpoint returns the stored staff_shifts row, with additional database fields.
